column1: # THE iq17-* RUNS' KNOWN DIVERGENCES FROM REAL SAP IQ 17.1 (IqParity.divergences; tools/iq-oracle/README.md, "The
# live IQ"). IQ island, landing 4 (WP1), 2026-10-14: real IQ 17.1 became the oracle of the iq17-* profiles, and these
# runs FAIL (a wrong answer), are a BUG (an answer where IQ raises an error) or an ERROR (an error where IQ answers),
# because lite follows SQL Anywhere's semantics where IQ's engine differs. Each is listed, not hidden, with its cause
# (measured on the live IQ by the corpus run of 2026-10-14, iqbuild/iqlive_corpus/report.md, and this snap).
# THE GUARD-FILE RULE (AGENTS.md; docs/FOUNDATIONS_PLAN.md §0.4): both IQ lanes fail on a FAIL, BUG or ERROR not
# listed here for their lane (a run SQL Anywhere judges may never be listed), and on a listed run that no longer
# diverges in a lane it lists (it PASSes, or is refused, or both error, or is skipped, or is gone): the list only
# shrinks. An entry is added only in a block under a dated comment naming the task that measured it; a fix removes
# its entries, and a cause no entry names any more.
# Lines: cause<TAB>id<TAB>what it is, then run<TAB>run key<TAB>cause id<TAB>lanes.

column3: integer arithmetic past a BIGINT: IQ's engine widens to a NUMERIC (BIGINT + 1 a NUMERIC(20,0), BIGINT * BIGINT a NUMERIC(39,0)), lite keeps a BIGINT, whose overflow the database raises; and IQ types by its data's range (k * 2 over small values a SMALLINT, its SUM a BIGINT) where lite types by the declared types' (IQ island, 2026-10-15: below a BIGINT lite widens as IQ does, 28 runs fixed)
the name IQ's engine gives an unaliased expression (its spelling, its parentheses, its case) is not SQL Anywhere's, which lite follows (WP2 item 3)
INTERSECT and EXCEPT over IQ tables are IQ's -1001030, which lite answers (WP2 item 4)

the IQ engine's other restrictions lite does not raise: a column or a non-constant expression in an IN list, a scalar subquery outside the top-level select list, ORDER BY a negative constant (WP2 item 4)
IQ 17.1's parser rejects TOP (expr), START AT (expr) and TOP ALL (-131), which lite reads (WP2 item 7)
two LISTs ordered differently: IQ answers with one order for both, where lite raises SQL Anywhere's -904 (WP2 item 6)

a non-string input to a string operation is an IQ error under its engine (-1001013, -1009145): LIKE over a number or a date, LEFT/SUBSTRING/UPPER of a date or a number, HOUR/MINUTE/SECOND of a DATE, LOCATE with a BIGINT start, an untyped NULL in arithmetic; lite answers (WP2 item 5)
CAST to LONG VARCHAR or TEXT over IQ tables is IQ's -1001006, which lite answers (WP2 item 5)
SUBSTRING's positions under IQ's engine: no ANSI virtual positions, NULL past the end (WP2 item 8)
LENGTH of a non-string under IQ's engine is its storage width, not its text's length (WP2 item 8)
ansinull Off reaches further under IQ's engine (a TDS login): IN lists holding NULL, NOT IN, LIKE NULL (WP2 item 9)
NOT BETWEEN with a NULL bound is UNKNOWN for every row under IQ's engine (WP2 item 9)
IS UNKNOWN over NOT IN of a subquery holding NULL: IQ's engine answers otherwise (WP2 item 9)
an untyped NULL's type under IQ's engine: an all-NULL CASE and MIN/MAX of NULL are VARCHAR (WP2 item 11)
the IQ engine's result types: CAST(x AS NUMERIC) is NUMERIC(126,38) (the PUBLIC precision and scale), TRUNCNUM and SIGN keep their argument's type (WP2 item 10, D-N1)
a narrowing CAST of a NUMERIC to a NUMERIC truncates under IQ's engine, where lite rounds as SQL Anywhere does (WP2 item 10)
MEDIAN of integers: IQ's engine truncates the midpoint toward zero, where lite floors (WP2 item 10)
blank padding with a tab: IQ's engine pads the shorter string with blanks before comparing (WP2 item 10)
EXP's underflow is NULL in IQ 17.1's front end, 0 in SQL Anywhere 17's (WP2 item 10)
ORDER BY (1) is a position under IQ's engine, a constant in SQL Anywhere's (WP2 item 10)
TRUE is a keyword in IQ 17.1, a name in SQL Anywhere 17 (WP2 item 10)
the CharSet UTF-8 database: CHAR(n) counts bytes, so a value with non-ASCII letters gets fewer blanks

a set operation's ORDER BY by a name is IQ's -1005012 under its engine, whatever the name (a column both branches show alike, an alias; measured on IQ 17.1, 2026-10-15); a position is read, and over DUMMY or through a derived table the name is too
a GROUP BY expression read by its alias in HAVING is IQ's -149 under its engine
IQ's own defects (WP5): EXISTS over an aggregate subquery is false where no row matches; the internal error -1006000 for ISNULL(LEFT(...)) beside a CASE of SUBSTRING
a DOUBLE beyond the largest is NULL under IQ's engine, which the island answers; Postgres raises its own float8 overflow before the island's test can read the infinity

a string read as a date where the database computes it: the island reads the year-first spellings every profile reads (IqFunctions.stringDate) and raises on another, which IQ reads by its own rules (a month's name, a two-digit year)
